description: Read the organization's enterprise audit trail: cursor-paginated security/SSO/SCIM/compliance events (who did what, when, from where) through the same reader the org-settings audit log and exports use. Optional filters: category (AUTH|SSO|SCIM|SECURITY_CONFIG|COMPLIANCE|IP_ALLOWLIST|CANDIDATE_DOCUMENTS|PARTICIPANT_WORK_EMAIL|AGREEMENT_ARTIFACTS — CANDIDATE_DOCUMENTS carries audited candidate resume-access events, DEV-2977; PARTICIPANT_WORK_EMAIL carries audited participant work-email access events, DEV-3031; AGREEMENT_ARTIFACTS carries audited agent downloads of signed agreements, OpenTrain Agreements PR-09c), action (e.g. login.failed, member.assignments_changed, resume_access_granted), from/to ISO-8601 bounds, cursor, limit (1-200, default 50). Requires enterprise:read scope on a PERSONAL token held by the ORGANIZATION OWNER; returns 404 while the enterprise_security feature is OFF (flag-dark, matching the org-settings UI).

action.description: Restrict to one dotted action, e.g. login.failed or member.assignments_changed.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page to continue pagination.

name: opentrain_enterprise_audit_events
